falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern relied on a higher low structure; breaking 4,800 would violate the key support zone and invalidate the 79% pattern match, proving it was not a bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 41 suggests controlled volatility; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling and regime change, falsifying the 'HOLD' signal which assumes no systemic stress event

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts by more than -50 basis points (i.e., -0.50% or steeper)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The current macro setup assumes stabilization; a deepening inversion beyond -50bps signals acute recession pricing that contradicts the bottoming narrative embedded in the pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
